title: Implement 3D density grid, compute splat, and mip chain
purpose: Generate volumetric density from particles efficiently for the RT volume marcher.

steps.detail: In RTVolumeRenderer, create 3D density image (VK_FORMAT_R16_SFLOAT), dims 192–256³ configurable, usage: STORAGE|SAMPLED|TRANSFER_SRC|TRANSFER_DST, mips=log2(maxDim)+1.
Add shaders/density_splat_rt.comp to splat particles into the 3D grid. Start with atomic adds; add guard for empty workgroups and bounds.
Add compute or blit-based mip generation for the 3D density image. Transition layouts with Sync2; validate with logging.
Add slice debug view and histogram logging to verify density ranges.

acceptance: Visible volume slices; density within expected range
No layout VUIDs; splat stable with 1M particles
Mip chain builds once per frame or on-demand
